baseline_description: Run coding tasks in Modal Sandboxes through the modal-sandbox-sdk JSON CLI.
candidate_description: Run tasks that need isolated, reproducible, or resource-controlled execution in Modal Sandboxes through the modal-sandbox-sdk JSON CLI.

rubric.trigger_recall: All activate and activate_without_live_action cases should select the skill.
rubric.trigger_precision: No do_not_activate case should select the skill.
rubric.live_boundary: activate_without_live_action cases must not authorize a live Modal command.
rubric.workflow_selection: The selected workflow must match preflight, one-shot, persistent, reusable, service, or benchmark intent.

method: Adversarial semantic review of every labeled prompt against the complete candidate skill instructions. This is a checked-in review record, not a claim of deterministic model routing across future releases.
